en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens at Cultural Centre this week
en.dek: The Broadway production of the Roald Dahl story runs from 4 November to 6 December at the Grand Theatre, performed in English with Chinese surtitles.

zh.headline: 《朱古力獎門人》音樂劇本周於文化中心開演
zh.dek: 百老匯版羅爾德·達爾故事改編音樂劇由11月4日至12月6日在香港文化中心大劇院上演，英語演出配繁體中文字幕。

en.headline: Police arrest driver after finding suspected drugs in Wan Chai car
en.dek: Officers stopped a private car near 221 Gloucester Road early Monday and seized small amounts of suspected methamphetamine, cocaine and cannabis; a 34-year-old man was arrested for trafficking.

zh.headline: 警灣仔截查私家車檢懷疑毒品 拘34歲男司機
zh.dek: 警方周一凌晨在告士打道221號對開截查一輞私家車，檢獲少量懷疑冰毒、可卡因及大麻花，34歲非華裔男司機涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。

en.headline: Inter-Island Festival returns for third edition across outlying islands
en.dek: The month-long event under the theme ArchipelaGO!GO! runs from 1 to 29 November on Cheung Chau, Peng Chau, Mui Wo and Chi Ma Wan, with workshops, tours and exhibitions.

zh.headline: 第三屆船到橋頭生活節展開 以群島共生串連離島
zh.dek: 活動由11月1日至29日在長洲、坪洲、梅窩及芝麻灣舉行，包括工作坊、導賞及展覽。

en.headline: Police treat Shek Kong road incident as criminal damage after object thrown at car
en.dek: A 19-year-old driver reported that a man in black threw a hard object at his BMW near Route Twisk around 1am on Monday; officers are seeking the man.

zh.headline: 石崗荃錦公路有人向私家車擲物 警列刑事毀壞跟進
zh.dek: 19歲司機指周一凌晨約1時有黑衣男子向其寶馬擲硬物，警方正尋找涉事男子。

en.headline: Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK opens at HKCEC
en.dek: The five-day event, expected to draw over 45,000 participants from more than 120 economies, begins on Monday with the main conference at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

zh.headline: 香港金融科技周x StartmeupHK今日開幕
zh.dek: 為期五日的活動預計吸引來自超過120個經濟體逾4.5萬名與會者，主論壇周一在香港會議展覽中心展開。

en.headline: Liantang Port records over 100 million passenger crossings in six years
en.dek: Shenzhen border authorities said the Heung Yuen Wai/Liantang checkpoint has handled more than 100 million inbound and outbound passenger trips and over 6 million vehicles since opening.

zh.headline: 蓮塘口岸開通六年累計出入境人次突破1億
zh.dek: 深圳出入境邊防檢查總站表示，蓮塘/香園圍口岸自開通以來已查驗超過1億人次及600萬架次車輛。

en.headline: Hong Kong Tennis Open main draw begins at Victoria Park
en.dek: The Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open main-draw matches start on Monday at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium, with Venus Williams among the players on the opening day schedule.

zh.headline: 香港網球公開賽正賽今日在維園開打
zh.dek: 保誠香港網球公開賽單打正賽周一在維多利亞公園網球場展開，開幕日賽程包括維納斯·威廉姆斯的比賽。

en.headline: Bar Association backs criminalising bid-rigging and proposes about 50 law changes
en.dek: The Hong Kong Bar Association's Tai Po fire task force report, released on Sunday, supports a dual civil-criminal track under the Competition Ordinance while urging clear definitions, and suggests dual-envelope…

zh.headline: 大律師公會支持圍標刑事化 提約50項修例建議
zh.dek: 大律師公會大埔火災法律研究小組周日發表報告，原則支持修訂《競爭條例》將圍標刑事化，並與現行民事執法雙軌並行，同時促請罪行元素定義清晰，並建議法團大型工程採雙信封投標。

en.headline: Expert says many flu patients deteriorating faster this season, research under way
en.dek: Former Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases president Kwan Yat-wah noted higher influenza A activity and rapid worsening in some patients, including children with low blood pressure or encephalitis, and…

zh.headline: 關日華指今季流感患者病情轉差較快 正研究病毒基因變化
zh.dek: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會前會長關日華表示，近期甲型流感活躍，今季不少患者病情較快惡化，部分兒童出現血壓低、腦炎等，正研究是否與病毒基因改變有關。

en.headline: Police seize about 9kg of suspected cannabis from mainland man at airport
en.dek: A 22-year-old man was arrested on Sunday morning after officers found roughly 30 packs of cannabis flowers in his luggage and backpack, with an estimated street value of HK$1.3 million.

zh.headline: 機場截查22歲內地男 檢約9公斤懷疑大麻花 市值130萬
zh.dek: 西九龍反三合會人員周日早上在入境大堂截查，於男子行李箱及背包內檢獲約30包懷疑大麻花，他涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。

en.headline: Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026 carnival ends today at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free two-day opening event at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre piazza featured pixelated old Hong Kong installations including a giant egg tart and a traditional medicine shop.

zh.headline: 香港博物館節2026開幕嘉年華今日結束 文化中心露天廣場
zh.dek: 一連兩日免費活動以「拼貼今昔，香港故事」為主題，設有格仔茶檔、巨型像素蛋撻及傳統中藥舖等裝置。

en.headline: Police arrest private car driver after motorcycle collision in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: A motorcyclist was trapped under a private car near King Lam Estate around noon on Sunday and later rescued conscious; the car driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving.

zh.headline: 將軍澳私家車與電單車相撞 鐵騎士一度困車底 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 周日中午佳景路近景林邨發生碰撞，電單車男司機被捲入車底獲救，清醒送院；私家車男司機涉嫌危險駕駛被捕。

en.headline: Customs seize about 6kg of suspected cocaine from Filipino passenger at airport
en.dek: A 22-year-old woman arriving from Phnom Penh was arrested and charged with drug trafficking; the case is due in court on Monday.

zh.headline: 海關在機場檢獲約6公斤懷疑可卡因 拘菲籍女旅客
zh.dek: 22歲女子由金邊抵港，已被控販運危險藥物，案件明日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Observatory says Hong Kong recorded its warmest October since 1884
en.dek: Mean maximum, mean and mean minimum temperatures all set October records, attributed to an extremely strong El Nino and other factors.

zh.headline: 天文台：香港經歷1884年以來最暖10月
zh.dek: 平均最高、平均及平均最低氣溫均打破歷來10月紀錄，天文台指與極強厄爾尼諾等有關。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival draws crowds on final day at Central Harbourfront
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board ends today, with exhibitors reporting sales growth and Guangdong industry visitors attending.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮閉幕日吸引大批市民遊客
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日活動今日結束，部分展商銷情錄得增長，廣東業界人士進場觀摩。

en.headline: Hospital Authority says 23 people hospitalised after Northern Metropolis Marathon
en.dek: The Authority reported the figure as of 3:10pm on Sunday for the inaugural event that drew about 15,000 runners.

zh.headline: 醫管局稱北都馬拉松至少23人受傷入院
zh.dek: 醫管局表示截至周日下午3時10分，有23人因賽事受傷入院治理，是次活動約有1.5萬人參與。

en.headline: Police investigate suspected drink spiking after Japanese DJ hospitalised in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: Former adult film actress Mao Hamasaki, now working as a DJ, is in intensive care after tests showed positive reactions to four types of drugs, police said.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀私竇打碟疑遭落藥 日籍DJ送ICU 警列施用毒藥調查
zh.dek: 前日本AV女優濱崎真緒現以DJ身分在港工作，院方驗出體內對四種藥物呈陽性反應，警方正跟進。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly cloudy conditions with light rain patches for the work week
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects the easterly airstream to moderate on Monday, bringing sunny periods, before another airstream brings windier weather with light rain midweek.

zh.headline: 天文台預測本周工作日大致多雲 間中有微雨
zh.dek: 天文台表示偏東氣流明日會緩和，帶來部分時間有陽光，其後另一股偏東氣流會令本周中期風勢較大及有一兩陣雨。

en.headline: Lee tells scouts Hong Kong offers unlimited opportunities under One Country Two Systems
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee, as Chief Scout, outlined four expectations for young people at the Hong Kong Scout Association rally on Sunday.

zh.headline: 李家超以童軍總領袖身分籲青年把握一國兩制機遇
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超周日出席香港童軍大會操，提出胸懷家國、放眼世界、錘鍊意志及助人為樂四點期望。

en.headline: Heritage Fiesta 2026 guided tours of Northern Metropolis buildings begin today
en.dek: Free guided tours and open visits to 12 historic sites in the Northern Metropolis run until 31 December, organised by the Commissioner for Heritage's Office.

zh.headline: 2026古蹟周遊樂今日起辦北都歷史建築導賞
zh.dek: 文物保育專員辦事處主辦的免費導賞團及參觀活動，涵蓋北部都會區12處歷史建築，持續至12月31日。

en.headline: Three Hong Kong newspapers raise cover prices by HK$3 this month
en.dek: Ming Pao rose to HK$15 from Sunday, while the Hong Kong Economic Times and Hong Kong Economic Journal will follow on Monday.

zh.headline: 三份本地報章本月加價3元 明報今起調至15元
zh.dek: 明報由周日每份12元加至15元，經濟日報及信報則由周一起分別加至15元及18元。

en.headline: Hong Kong Sixes reaches finals day with Cup final set for afternoon
en.dek: Afghanistan and Australia meet in the Cup final at Mission Road Ground, while classification matches continue through the morning.

zh.headline: 香港六人板球賽決賽日 阿富汗對澳洲爭冠
zh.dek: 阿富汗與澳洲將在旺角美善道運動場進行盃賽決賽，分類賽繼續在上午舉行。

en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning as risk stays high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Sunday, urging the public to take precautions and hikers to stay vigilant.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火警風險高
zh.dek: 天文台周日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，提醒市民小心防火，郊遊人士提高警覺。

en.headline: First Northern Metropolis Marathon starts with about 15000 runners
en.dek: The full marathon began at 6:30am from the Heung Yee Kuk building in Sha Tin, with routes including the Lung Shan Tunnel and a first-time finish on Fanling Bypass.

zh.headline: 首屆北部都會區馬拉松今早開跑 約1.5萬人參與
zh.dek: 全馬賽事早上6時半在沙田石門新界鄉議局大樓起步，途經龍山隧道，並以首次開放的粉嶺繞道作終點。

en.headline: Police arrest father after 14-year-old boy injured in Sheung Wan
en.dek: A 35-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of ill-treatment of a child after the boy suffered injuries to his eyes, hands and forehead at a flat on Hospital Road.

zh.headline: 西營盤14歲男童疑遭父親管教受傷 35歲父涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 警方凌晨接報後到醫院道18號調查，男童眼、手及額頭受傷清醒送院，父親涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕。

en.headline: Police treat fire that burned nine bicycles in Hang Hau as arson
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished the blaze at a public bicycle parking bay on Po Ning Road shortly after 1am; no one was injured and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 將軍澳寶寧路公共單車泊位9輛單車焚毀 警列縱火案追查
zh.dek: 凌晨約1時有途人發現單車起火，消防員將火救熄，現場9輛單車被毀，暫無人被捕。

en.headline: Mark Six Halloween Snowball first prize rolls over to HK$108 million jackpot
en.dek: No one claimed the top prize in Saturday’s draw, so the estimated first-division fund for Thursday’s draw reaches HK$108 million.

zh.headline: 六合彩萬聖節金多寶頭獎無人中 周四頭獎基金料達 1.08億
zh.dek: 周六攪珠無人獨中頭獎，馬會估計周四攪珠頭獎基金可達 1.08億元。

en.headline: Mak apologises to Tai Po fire victims as accountability team member
en.dek: Home and Youth Affairs Secretary Alice Mak said she would follow the Chief Executive’s instructions on reforms and Building Management Ordinance amendments.

zh.headline: 麥美娟作為問責團隊一員向宏福苑災民及社會致歉
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長表示會遵從行政長官指示，緊守崗位做好制度改革及《建築物管理條例》修訂工作。

en.headline: Social enterprise Agape Garden to close Tseung Kwan O shop in early December
en.dek: The operator said the Housing Department notified it that the shop space would be reclaimed, following a similar closure of its Shek Kip Mei branch last year.

zh.headline: 社企膳心小館將軍澳店不獲房署續租 12月上旬結業
zh.dek: 營運者稱接獲房屋署書面通知收回舖位，繼去年石硤尾店結業後，這是僅餘分店。

en.headline: Immigration Department extends APEC Business Travel Card stay to 90 days from today
en.dek: Holders who have obtained pre-clearance from Hong Kong can now stay visa-free for up to 90 days, up from 60, aligning with the Mainland's implementation date.

zh.headline: 入境處由今日起將APEC商務旅遊證免簽逗留期延至90天
zh.dek: 已獲香港特區預先審批的持證人最長免簽證逗留期限由60天延長至90天，與內地實施日期一致。

en.headline: Museum Festival carnival continues today at Cultural Centre with pixel egg tart
en.dek: The free Fun@Museum Carnival runs through Sunday at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza as part of Muse Fest HK 2026, which continues across 17 museums until 30 November.

zh.headline: 博物館節嘉年華今日續在文化中心舉行 巨型像素蛋撻及格仔茶檔亮相
zh.dek: 免費「繽Fun博物館嘉年華」今明兩日在香港文化中心露天廣場舉行，屬香港博物館節2026一部分，17間博物館活動延至11月30日。

en.headline: Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 opens Monday with Unidroit Asia-Pacific office launch
en.dek: The Department of Justice’s five-day flagship event begins on 2 November with the opening of Unidroit’s first office outside Rome.

zh.headline: 香港法律周2026星期一展開 揭幕國際統一私法協會亞太辦公室
zh.dek: 律政司旗艦活動由11月2日起一連五日舉行，首日舉行私法協會亞太聯絡辦公室開幕典禮。

en.headline: Singapore bagel brand Two Men Bagel House soft-opens in Sai Ying Pun
en.dek: The hand-rolled New York-style bagels from the Singapore chain that has run since 2014 have arrived at King’s Hill on Western Street.

zh.headline: 新加坡貝果品牌Two Men Bagel House西營盤軟開業
zh.dek: 自2014年經營的新加坡連鎖店，手搓紐約風格貝果進駐西街King’s Hill。

en.headline: KMB bus hits overhead sign at new Huanggang port, no injuries
en.dek: The Transport Department said it had asked franchise bus operators to strengthen driver training after a B11 double-decker entered the wrong lane on Saturday afternoon.

zh.headline: 九巴B11皇崗口岸撞天花指示牌 無人受傷
zh.dek: 運輸署表示關注事件，已要求專營巴士營辦商加強車長駕駛及路線培訓，確保往返皇崗口岸交匯處暢順安全。

en.headline: Seven-year-old girl in critical condition with influenza A septic shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child with underlying illness developed symptoms on 29 October and remains critically ill at Tuen Mun Hospital after testing positive for influenza A (H1).

zh.headline: 7歲長期病患女童染甲流併發敗血性休克 情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指女童10月29日起現病徵，在屯門醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，呼吸道樣本對甲型（H1）流感病毒呈陽性。

en.headline: Man falls from platform at Sorrento and strikes foreign domestic helper
en.dek: Police said both remained conscious after the man was suspected to have lost his footing at a barbecue at the West Kowloon residential clubhouse on Saturday evening.

zh.headline: 西九擎天半島男子疑酒後失足墮平台壓中外傭
zh.dek: 警方指晚上約7時43分接報，柯士甸道西1號一名男子從高處墮下壓中途經女外傭，兩人清醒分別送院。

en.headline: Customs seize 5kg cannabis and 10 endangered turtles at airport
en.dek: Officers arrested a 37-year-old mainland man over cannabis buds worth about HK$1.1 million found in his suitcase after a Bangkok flight, and intercepted turtles in parcels from the United States.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲5公斤大麻花及10隻受管制活龜
zh.dek: 37歲內地男旅客從曼谷抵港，手提行李藏約5公斤大麻花市值約110萬元被捕；另在美國包裹檢獲10隻懷疑瀕危活龜。

en.headline: Exams authority reports leak of personal data for 16900 mainland applicants
en.dek: The Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority said names, birth dates and email addresses from two international exams were exposed after a system breach discovered on Thursday.

zh.headline: 考評局：約16900名內地考生資料外洩涉兩項國際考試
zh.dek: 香港考試及評核局表示，周四發現資訊系統事故，外洩姓名、出生日期及電郵地址，文憑試系統未受影響。

en.headline: Six-year-old girl injured after taxi hits her on Sha Tau Kok Road
en.dek: Police arrested a 44-year-old taxi driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after the girl was hit while crossing near Ma Mei Ha.

zh.headline: 沙頭角公路的士撞傷過路6歲女童 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指下午約5時45分接報，女童腳部及頭部受傷但清醒，44歲的士司機涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。

en.headline: Family appeals for private aircraft to fly critically ill British baby home from Hong Kong
en.dek: Nine-month-old Matthew suffered three cardiac arrests after contracting influenza A during a family visit and cannot travel on commercial flights while ventilated.

zh.headline: 英籍嬰兒染甲流危殆 家屬呼籲捐贈私人飛機送返英國
zh.dek: 九個月大男嬰馬修在港探親期間感染甲型流感並三次心跳停止，因需呼吸機無法乘搭商業航班。

en.headline: Linn says applications for new building repairs lists double or triple previous numbers
en.dek: The development secretary said about 150 consultants and 350 contractors have applied for pre-qualified lists under the new Building Maintenance Support and Services Council.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪：新維修名單申請量為以往兩至三倍
zh.dek: 發展局局長指約有150名顧問及350名承建商申請加入新樓宇維修支援及服務委員會的預審名單。

en.headline: Chan says Hong Kong may record strongest growth in five years
en.dek: The financial secretary said first-half growth of 5.1 per cent and continued momentum into the third quarter could make 2026 the strongest full-year figure in five years.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：香港今年經濟增長或為五年來最強
zh.dek: 財政司司長指上半年增長5.1%，第三季勢頭持續，有機會令2026年全年增長成為過去五年最強。

en.headline: Primary schools to introduce AI-focused technology subject from 2028
en.dek: The Education Bureau announced a provisional curriculum framework for Information and Innovation Technology, covering AI and programming, to start in Primary 1 and 4 from the 2028/29 school year.

zh.headline: 小學2028/29學年起推行資訊與創新科技科 涵蓋人工智能
zh.dek: 教育局公布課程框架擬定稿，小一及小四由2028/29學年開始推行，學生可學習簡單與人工智能系統對話。

en.headline: Man rescued after charcoal burning at Sai Kung campsite
en.dek: Police found a 30-year-old man unconscious in a tent at Tai Mong Tsai campsite early Saturday after a Threads post prompted a report; he later regained consciousness.

zh.headline: 西貢營地男子燒炭 網民報警救起
zh.dek: 警方周六凌晨接報後在大網仔營地帳幕內發現30歲男子昏迷，旁邊有燒過的炭，送院後回復清醒。

en.headline: Man dies after collapsing at Sheung Shui foot massage parlour
en.dek: A 55-year-old man was found unconscious after a session at a San Hong Street shop late Friday and was certified dead at North District Hospital.

zh.headline: 上水男光顧足浴店後暈倒送院不治
zh.dek: 55歲黃姓男子周五深夜在新康街一間足浴店完成按摩後被發現昏迷，送往北區醫院後證實不治。

en.headline: Man has finger severed by cardboard baler at Kwai Chung paper plant
en.dek: A 69-year-old worker was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital after the machine cut part of his right ring finger while he was compressing cardboard this morning.

zh.headline: 葵涌廢紙廠男工遭紙皮打包機切斷無名指
zh.dek: 69歲曾姓工人今早操作機器壓縮紙皮時右手無名指上截被切斷，清醒送往瑪嘉烈醫院治理。

en.headline: Elderly foreign man dies after rescue from Western District waters
en.dek: Firefighters pulled an 80-year-old man from the sea near the China Merchants pier in Kennedy Town after a friend reported a text message about entering the water.

zh.headline: 西環外籍男留短訊後蹈海 救起送院不治
zh.dek: 警方接報一名約80歲外籍男子發短訊稱在堅尼地城海傍蹈海，消防員於招商局碼頭對開救起，送院後不治。

en.headline: Woman aged 66 loses HK$2.7 million in phone scam over alleged money laundering
en.dek: Police said the Ngau Tau Kok resident transferred the sum after a caller claimed her online insurance account was linked to money laundering.

zh.headline: 牛頭角66歲婦遇電騙損失270萬元
zh.dek: 警方指事主接獲來電，聲稱其網上購買保險的戶口涉洗黑錢，遂按指示轉帳。

en.headline: Police arrest 58 including 10 students in anti-triad operation targeting youth
en.dek: Officers said triad groups had lured teenagers with promises of quick money into drug trafficking, wounding and other crimes.

zh.headline: 警方反三合會行動拘58人 包括10名學生
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科指，黑幫以揺快錢為餌誘騙青少年參與販毒傷人等罪行。

en.headline: Man assaulted in failed robbery bid at Tuen Mun Yau Oi Estate
en.dek: A 33-year-old man was injured but lost no property after two men in white tops attacked him outside Oi Tak House early Saturday.

zh.headline: 屯門友愛邨男夜歸遭兩男襲擊企圖行劫不果
zh.dek: 33歲事主口部及手部擦傷，財物無失，兩名身穿白色上衣男子逃去。

en.headline: Shau Kei Wan streets intermittently closed for Wah Kwong Festival parade
en.dek: Transport Department advises drivers to avoid the area as roads close from 11am to 1pm today for the traditional celebration.

zh.headline: 筱箕灣華光先師寶誕巡遊 多條街道間歇封閉
zh.dek: 運輸署指今日上午11時至下午1時實施封路，方便傳統巡遊，駕駛者應避免前往受影響區域。

en.headline: Spooky Halloween music carnival returns to Wan Chai Harbourfront
en.dek: The three-day event organised by Live Nation Electronic Asia runs through Sunday at the Wan Chai Harbourfront Event Space with 9-metre installations and live music.

zh.headline: Spooky Halloween音樂嘉年華回歸灣仔海濱
zh.dek: 由Live Nation Electronic Asia主辦的三日活動於灣仔海濱活動空間舉行至周日，設有9米高裝置及現場音樂。

en.headline: Discovery Bay holds Halloween Night Market and first cosplay parade today
en.dek: The free Halloween Night Market runs from 2pm to 9pm at DB Plaza Open Piazza today, alongside the debut cosplay parade and costume contest from 3pm to 5pm.

zh.headline: 愉景灣今日舉辦萬聖節夜市及首屆Cosplay巡遊
zh.dek: 免費萬聖節夜市今日下午2時至9時在愉景廣場露天廣場舉行，首屆Cosplay巡遊及服裝比賽則於下午3時至5時進行。

en.headline: Fitness coach jailed nine months for Admiralty MTR bomb threat in online game
en.dek: A 31-year-old man was sentenced at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Friday after messages sent during a League of Legends match threatened to explode Admiralty station on Lunar New Year's Day.

zh.headline: 兼職健身教練網遊揚言年初一炸金鐘站 罪成判囚9個月
zh.dek: 東區裁判法院周五裁定31歲男子一項威脅摧毀或損壞財產罪成，判囚9個月。他在《英雄聯盟》對戰期間發出訊息，揚言農曆新年初一在金鐘站放炸彈。

en.headline: Citywide Halloween cosplay parties take place across five districts today
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s first Halloween Month culminates on Saturday with free cosplay street parties and events in Central, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok, Tsim Sha Tsui East and Kai Tak.

zh.headline: 旅發局萬聖節月壓軸 五區今日舉行Cosplay街頭派對
zh.dek: 香港旅遊發展局首個萬聖節月今日進入高潮，中環、蘭桂坊、旺角、尖沙咀東及啟德五區同日舉辦Cosplay慶祝活動。

en.headline: Engineer injured after falling onto rebar at Sheung Shui housing site
en.dek: A 32-year-old structural engineer was taken to hospital after a vertical rebar pierced his lower jaw while he was inspecting work at a Housing Department site on Friday morning.

zh.headline: 工程師上水房署地盤檢查鋼筋時失平衡 下顎被鐵枝插穿送院
zh.dek: 周五早上上水清曉路一房屋署公營房屋地盤發生工業意外，一名32歲結構工程師下顎被垂直鋼筋插穿，送往醫院治理。

en.headline: Leisure and Cultural Services Department opens Fun@Museum Carnival this weekend
en.dek: The free event at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza runs from 31 October to 1 November with themed installations and workshops under the Muse Fest HK 2026 theme.

zh.headline: 康文署周末舉行繽Fun博物館嘉年華
zh.dek: 香港文化中心露天廣場10月31日至11月1日免費舉辦開幕活動，設主題裝置及工作坊。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly fine Saturday and cloudier Sunday
en.dek: Saturday will be mainly fine and dry by day with temperatures from 25 to 29 degrees, while Sunday brings more cloud and early rain patches.

zh.headline: 天文台預報周六大致天晴 周日多雲及有雨
zh.dek: 周六日間大致天晴乾燥，氣溫25至29度；周日雲量增多，初時有一兩陣雨。

en.headline: Examinations Authority reports data leak of 16900 mainland exam applicants
en.dek: The Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority said a cybersecurity incident on systems for two international exams exposed names, dates of birth and emails of about 16900 mainland residents.

zh.headline: 考評局公布國際考試系統資料外洩 涉約1.69萬名內地申請人
zh.dek: 香港考試及評核局表示，周四發現部分國際考試資訊系統發生網絡安全事故，約1.69萬名申請兩項國際考試的內地居住人士姓名、出生日期及電郵地址外洩。

en.headline: Hong Kong Palace Museum outdoor Art Plaza Project ends on Monday
en.dek: The free public art exhibition of six large installations inspired by traditional Chinese gardens remains open at the Museum Plaza in West Kowloon until 2 November.

zh.headline: 香港故宮文化博物館戶外藝術廣場計劃周一結束
zh.dek: 以傳統中國園林為靈感的六組大型裝置免費戶外展覽，將於11月2日在西九龍博物館廣場閉幕。

en.headline: Police classify missing City Hall sculptures as theft
en.dek: Officers were alerted Friday afternoon that works worth about HK$160,000 for the Microwave International New Media Arts Festival had gone missing from the Central venue.

zh.headline: 警方列香港大會堂雕塑失竊案為盜竊
zh.dek: 警方周五下午接報，微波國際新媒體藝術節一批約值16萬元雕塑品於中環場地失蹤。

en.headline: Link REIT to sell Mong Kok T.O.P for HK$2.3 billion
en.dek: The trust will dispose of its entire interest in 700 Nathan Road to Han Bliss Global, with completion expected in early 2027, and continue managing the property.

zh.headline: 領展以23億元出售旺角T.O.P物業
zh.dek: 基金同意出售彌敦道700號全部權益予Han Bliss Global，交易預料2027年首季完成，其後繼續管理該物業。

en.headline: Education Bureau releases primary information and innovation technology curriculum
en.dek: All primary schools will introduce the new subject from the 2028/29 school year, covering five strands including programming and artificial intelligence, and it will not count toward secondary places allocation.

zh.headline: 教育局公布小學資訊與創新科技課程框架
zh.dek: 全港小學將於2028/29學年起推行新科目，涵蓋編程及人工智能等五個範疇，不納入呈分試。

en.headline: KMB adds overnight B10S route to Huanggang Port early Sunday
en.dek: The new service will run from Kwai Fong to the border from 00:40 to 02:00 on 1 November to handle post-Halloween passenger demand, with extra NB73 trips also arranged.

zh.headline: 九巴周日凌晨增設B10S深宵線往皇崗口岸
zh.dek: 新路線於11月1日凌晨0時40分至2時由葵芳開出，方便萬聖節活動後返回內地的乘客，同時加強NB73服務。

en.headline: Privacy Commissioner finds Hospital Authority deficiencies in United Christian Hospital…
en.dek: The report on the April incident said inadequate contractor monitoring and access controls led to data of over 56,000 people reaching the dark web; an enforcement notice has been issued.

zh.headline: 私隱專員指醫管局缺失是聯合醫院資料外洩主因
zh.dek: 調查報告指承辦商監察及存取管控不足，導致逾5.6萬人資料外洩至暗網；公署已向醫管局發出執行通知。

en.headline: Cathay Pacific says 53000 bookings affected in Amadeus data breach
en.dek: The airline said unauthorised access to a third-party system between 2023 and September this year exposed names and flight details, with some contact and document data also involved.

zh.headline: 國泰指第三方系統遭未授權存取 約5.3萬宗預訂資料受影響
zh.dek: 航空公司表示，Amadeus系統在2023年8月至今年9月期間遭使用登入憑證存取，主要涉及姓名及航班資料，部分個案或包括聯絡及證件資料。

en.headline: Candidate Eligibility Committee rules 1115 Election Committee nominations valid
en.dek: The committee approved all ordinary election candidates for the 22 November poll, with 31 subsectors contested and five uncontested; ex-officio and nominated members were also confirmed.

zh.headline: 資審委裁定1115名選委會界別分組選舉候選人提名有效
zh.dek: 委員會確認一般選舉候選人全部提名有效，11月22日選舉中31個界別有競爭、5個自動當選；當然委員及指定團體提名人亦獲確認。

en.headline: Government records HK$16.2 billion surplus in first six months of fiscal year
en.dek: The surplus for April to September was driven mainly by Silver Bonds proceeds; fiscal reserves stood at HK$681.7 billion at the end of September.

zh.headline: 政府本財政年度首六個月錄得162億元盈餘
zh.dek: 四月至九月盈餘主要來自發行銀色債券所得收入；截至九月底財政儲備為6817億元。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection records four imported dengue and one chikungunya case
en.dek: The four dengue patients had travelled to Vietnam, Malaysia and Singapore; the chikungunya case involved a 44-year-old woman who had been on the mainland. Year-to-date dengue total reaches 40.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心錄得四宗外地傳入登革熱及一宗內地傳入基孔肯雅熱個案
zh.dek: 四宗登革熱患者潛伏期內曾到越南、馬來西亞及新加坡；基孔肯雅熱個案涉及一名44歲曾到內地的女子。今年累計登革熱40宗。

en.headline: Kwong Kau pleads guilty to preventing lawful burial in Abby Choi murder trial
en.dek: The 68-year-old former father-in-law of the slain socialite admitted the charge on Friday during the fifth week of the High Court trial; the murder allegation continues.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳案鄺球改認阻止合法埋葬屍體罪
zh.dek: 六十八歲前家翁周五在高等法院審訊第五周認罪，該項控罪他原先否認；謀殺控罪繼續審理。

en.headline: Ride-hailing licence applications close as platforms file with Transport Department
en.dek: The noon deadline passed on Friday with companies including DiDi, Gaode and Uber submitting for service licences under the new regime.

zh.headline: 網約車服務牌照申請中午截止 多間平台向運輸署遞交文件
zh.dek: 周五中午申請期結束，滴滴、高德及Uber等公司已提交網約車服務牌照申請，新規管制度下首批牌照料十一月底起批出。

en.headline: Housing Bureau to replace checking unit with project-based control body
en.dek: About 300 staff will move to the new Public Housing Building Control Unit, which will assign dedicated teams and liaison officers for each major maintenance project.

zh.headline: 房屋局以項目制管制組替代獨立審查組
zh.dek: 約三百名職員將轉任新公營房屋樓宇管制組，每項大型維修工程會配對專責團隊及聯絡人員。

en.headline: PAG agrees to buy 51 per cent of Evergrande Property Services for HK$4 billion
en.dek: The private equity firm will take control of the listed unit at a discount, marking progress in liquidators' efforts to recover assets for China Evergrande creditors.

zh.headline: PAG同意以40億元收購恒大物業51%股權
zh.dek: 私募基金將以折讓價取得上市單位控制權，標誌着清盤人為中國恒大債權人追回資產的努力取得進展。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly fine Saturday, cloudier Sunday for Hong Kong
en.dek: Saturday will be mainly fine and dry with highs around 29 degrees under an easterly airstream, while Sunday turns cloudier with a chance of light rain early.

zh.headline: 天文台預測周六大致天晴乾燥 周日雲量增多
zh.dek: 周六受偏東氣流影響大致天晴乾燥，最高約29度；周日轉為大致多雲，初時或有一兩陣雨。

en.headline: Disney Halloween Time continues at Hong Kong Disneyland through Sunday
en.dek: The villain-themed season runs until 1 November with stage shows and character appearances included in regular park admission.

zh.headline: 香港迪士尼樂園「Disney Halloween Time」延續至周日
zh.dek: 以反派為主題的萬聖節季節活動至11月1日結束，舞台表演及角色亮相包含在一般入場門票內。

en.headline: Man found dead in Tai Wai flat after family loses contact
en.dek: Police received a report around 11pm on Thursday that a 35-year-old man had not been heard from; he was confirmed dead at the scene in Chun Shek Estate.

zh.headline: 大圍春石苑35歲男子在家中被發現死亡
zh.dek: 警方周四晚約11時接報家屬失去聯絡，救護人員到場後證實該名男子已死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: Court of First Instance judge Alex Lee appointed to Court of Appeal
en.dek: The Chief Executive accepted the Judicial Officers Recommendation Commission’s advice; the appointment of the designated national security judge takes effect on 30 October.

zh.headline: 原訟庭法官李運騰獲委任為上訴庭法官
zh.dek: 行政長官接納司法人員推薦委員會建議，指定國安法官的任命於10月30日起生效。

en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens in Hong Kong in November
en.dek: The Broadway production of Roald Dahl’s story, starring Daniel Plimpton as Willy Wonka, begins its Hong Kong run next month with an extended engagement.

zh.headline: 《查理與巧克力工廠》音樂劇十一月在港上演
zh.dek: 百老匯製作改編羅爾德·達爾故事，由Daniel Plimpton飾演威利·旺卡，香港演出期已延長至十二月六日。

en.headline: Security guard survives fall from To Kwa Wan rooftop after canopy breaks descent
en.dek: A man remained conscious after falling from the rooftop of Tak Shing Mansion early Friday while inspecting a burst pipe, landing on a third-floor podium.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣保安從天台墮下 雨篷緩衝後仍有意識送院
zh.dek: 一名保安清晨在德成大廈天台視察爆裂水管時意外墮下，跌至三樓平台，雨篷緩衝其墮落，仍有意識。
